rationale.rgb_downscale: The locked training input is 640 px (ADR-001). FLAME 3 ships 8000x6000 visible frames at ~20 MB each; decoding those per sample makes the dataloader, not the GPU, the bottleneck. Capping the long side at 1280 keeps 2x headroom for the +/-0.3 scale augmentation and the SSL random-resized crop while cutting the RGB payload by more than an order of magnitude. Bounding boxes are unaffected because D-Fire stores them in normalised YOLO coordinates.
rationale.thermal_never_resampled: Resampling or lossily re-encoding a radiometric raster destroys the measurement that makes the thermal source scientifically interesting. Thermal frames keep their original grid and are written as lossless float32.
rationale.thermal_to_celsius: Storing Celsius makes the curated dataset self-describing and lets thermal normalisation use physically motivated limits instead of blind percentiles (manuscript section 3.6.2). The conversion is an exactly invertible affine map.
rationale.one_representation_per_frame: FLAME 3 provides each thermal frame as raw counts, an orthorectified Celsius product, a rendered colour map, and a FLIR container. Only the raw counts are ingested: the colour map carries no radiometric information, the orthorectified product is a resampled derivative, and ingesting several would multiply the source and mix incompatible semantics.
rationale.allow_list: Inclusion is an allow-list of directory globs rather than a deny-list, so a subdirectory added by a future dataset release cannot be ingested without a deliberate recipe change.

dfire.name: dfire
dfire.notes: Layout already matches the adapter. Label .txt files are copied byte-for-byte, including the zero-byte files that mean 'annotated, and there is nothing here'.

wildfire.name: wildfire
wildfire.notes: The v2 release has no sub-taxonomy folders under fire/ and nofire/, so the smoke-only exclusion of rule D2 caveat 2 cannot be applied. Recorded as a limitation rather than worked around.

flame3.name: flame3

exclude_reasons.geo_thermal_tiff_celsius: orthorectified derivative of raw_thermal_tiff; resampled, and its 0.00 minimum is a nodata border rather than 0 C, which would drag the normalisation percentiles to zero
exclude_reasons.raw_thermal_jpg: rendered colour map; carries no radiometric information and would duplicate every thermal frame
exclude_reasons.raw_thermal_irg: FLIR proprietary container; unreadable by any imaging library
exclude_reasons.GCPs: ground-control points, GIS vector data rather than imagery
exclude_reasons.metadata: a weather screenshot and a brief map, not observations
exclude_reasons.*_ortho.tif / *_dtm.tif / *_pointcloud.l: photogrammetry products, hundreds of MB each, not per-frame imagery

thermal_conversion.evidence: int16 rasters with median ~3008 and max ~4714. Dividing by 10 and subtracting 273.15 reproduces the release's own Celsius product to within the error expected from orthorectification (max 198.3 vs 197.0 C; median 27.7 vs 29.7 C). Cross-checked per frame by build_curated_dataset.py, which records the measured agreement.

flame3.notes: Restructured into plot/phase/modality, because plot is the correlated unit that must not cross a split and phase carries the label signal. The provenance table maps every curated file back to its raw path and hash.
